name: High Elven Bracers
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 273
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 8th
Slot wrist; Price 30,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
These finely crafted leather bracers have plates of silvered steel covering the back, and silver buckles at the wrist and forearm. The bracers enable the wearer to use any traditional elven weapon (longbows, composite longbows, longswords, rapiers, shortbows, composite shortbows, and any weapon with the word “elven” in its name) as if he were proficient in its use. If he uses such a weapon and is already proficient with it, he gains a +1 competence bonus on attack and damage rolls. Both bracers must be worn for the magic to be effective.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, Craft Magic Arms and Armor, creator must be an elf; Cost 15,000 gp
